target_format: BIP39 mnemonic, 12 or 24 words, English, encoded in an 11x11 pixel grid using an 11-color base-11 palette, BIP44 m/44'/60'/0'/0/0, no passphrase

derivation.summary: read the 121-pixel grid (an 11-color palette read as base-11 digits) in a traversal order into a bit string, pack it into BIP39 word indices, derive an Ethereum address at m/44'/60'/0'/0/0, compare to a known escrow; two schemes (a boustrophedon triple-repetition for piece #869, a color-partition split for piece #993) are fully reconstructed and certified; the scheme used for piece #930 and for the active puzzle is not
derivation.certified_against: piece #993, whose reconstructed mnemonic reproduces its escrow address exactly (the escrow has since been reclaimed by the artist, not a live prize)

difficulty_note: the active puzzle's escrow does not exist on Ethereum mainnet as of the last check; even once it does, its encoding scheme is not yet identified, and the strongest lead is a set of author-distributed hints in a gated community chat
